sections.text: You wake up in what seems to be a dark prison cell, on an old wooden bed. Metal bars are preventing you to escape from the room. There is no window. Somewhere above you, a bell tolls midnight.

options.description: You try to open the door
You run your hands along the walls

sections.text: You don't see anything, it's too dark.

options.description: Try to scan the area with your hands

consequence.text: As you move your hands left and right under the bed, you cut yourself on a rusty nail.

options.description: Give up and get back on your feet

sections.text: Your fingers close on something cold and heavy: an old door key.

options.description: Try to open the door with the key

sections.text: One brick near the floor is loose. Behind it you find a stale crust of bread, a folded scrap of paper, and a cold draft of air.

options.description: Eat the bread, then read the paper

consequence.text: It is as hard as stone, but your stomach stops aching.

options.description: Leave the bread, it smells strange, and read the paper

sections.text: The note reads, in a shaky hand: "The captain at the gate asks for the word. The word is LANTERN. Never touch the idol." The draft comes from a narrow tunnel behind the brick.

consequence.text: The stones scrape your knees and elbows raw.

sections.text: The tunnel slopes down and ends at a crumbling wall. Through the cracks you hear dripping water, and something that sounds like a chant.

consequence.text: The wall gives way, and so does your ankle.

sections.text: Heavy boots echo in the corridor. A one-eyed guard presses his face against the bars. "Shut it, or I'll shut it for you."

consequence.text: He reaches through the bars and slams your head against the metal.

options.description: Pretend you are dying of fever
Apologize and go back to bed

sections.text: The guard grumbles, unlocks the door and leans over you. His keys dangle from his belt.

consequence.text: He catches your arm and twists it before you break free and lock him in.
He kicks you in the ribs, laughs, and locks the door again.

sections.text: You step into a long corridor lit by a dying torch. To the left, snoring comes from the guard room. To the right, a door is marked with a red cross. Straight ahead, a stairway spirals down into darkness.

options.description: Open the door with the red cross

sections.text: A fat guard sleeps in a chair, his uniform jacket and helmet hanging on a hook. Another door leads to the kitchen.

options.description: Take the uniform and the helmet
Knock him out first, just in case

consequence.text: He wakes up as you lift the stool. The fight is short, but painful.

options.description: Tiptoe past him to the kitchen

sections.text: The guard lies unconscious on the floor. You are shaking, but you are alone.
The uniform is two sizes too big, but with the helmet on, nobody will look at you twice. The main gate is across the courtyard.

options.description: Walk confidently to the main gate

sections.text: The infirmary smells of vinegar. Clean bandages lie on a table, next to two vials: one glowing blue, one deep red. Footsteps are coming down the corridor.

consequence.text: The bandages are clean and tight. You feel much better.
A cold fire runs through your veins. You feel stronger than ever.
It burns all the way down. Something inside you will never be the same.

sections.text: The footsteps stop in front of the door. You slip out through the back window onto a narrow ledge.

options.description: Drop down into the kitchen yard

consequence.text: You land badly on the cobblestones.

sections.text: You reach a damp cellar. In the middle stands a stone idol covered in green moss, with two rubies for eyes. In a corner there is a trapdoor, and against the wall, a rusty sewer grate.

options.description: Pry the rubies out of the idol

consequence.text: Hidden needles bite into your fingers. The idol's venom seeps into your blood.
There is no bottom you can survive. The fall is very, very long.

sections.text: Your hand is numb and swollen, and the rubies did not even move. Behind the idol, the wall is wet: the sewers are close.
You drop into the sewers. Black water flows towards a faint light at the end of the tunnel. Something big moves in the dark.

consequence.text: The water is freezing, and full of things you would rather not name.

sections.text: The current carries you to an iron grid. Beyond it, moonlight shines on a river. The grid is rusted through at the bottom.

consequence.text: The rusted bars tear at your back as you squeeze under them.

sections.text: Halfway along the ledge, a pack of rats the size of cats blocks the way.

consequence.text: Teeth everywhere. You make it through, bleeding, and slip into the water.

options.description: Go back up to the cellar

sections.text: The door is locked.

consequence.text: You're getting a little crazier...

sections.text: The kitchen is warm. A pot of stew simmers over the fire, and the cook snores on a sack of flour. A laundry chute opens in the wall, and a back door leads to the courtyard.

consequence.text: Hot meat, onions and bread. For a moment, you forget all your wounds.

options.description: Sneak out through the back door

sections.text: The cook wakes up, sees you with the ladle in your hand, and grabs a cleaver.

consequence.text: The cleaver catches your shoulder before you knock him down with the pot, and run outside.

sections.text: You slide down the chute and land in a pile of dirty sheets. A cart full of linen is waiting to leave the castle.
The courtyard is bathed in moonlight. Guards patrol the walls. A hay cart stands near the gate while its driver drinks at the well. Ivy covers the wall up to the rooftops.

consequence.text: The ivy tears off halfway up, and you scrape your hands catching yourself.

options.description: Steal the driver's horse and charge the gate

consequence.text: Arrows whistle past you. One of them finds your leg.

sections.text: At the main gate, a scarred captain looks you up and down. "Night shift is over already? Give me the word, soldier."

consequence.text: "Wrong answer." The captain's sword is faster than you.

sections.text: The captain narrows his eye and calls two guards. "Take this one back to the cells."

consequence.text: Fists, boots, a sword pommel. You break free and run into the courtyard.
They take the uniform, beat you, and throw you back in your cell.

sections.text: You are on the rooftops. The moat glitters far below. Beyond the outer wall, the branches of an old oak reach towards you.

consequence.text: You catch a branch, then another one, then the ground. Hard.
The moat is only knee-deep.

options.description: Walk along the ridge to the gatehouse

sections.text: From the gatehouse roof you can see the guards below. A rope hangs down the outer wall, and a hay cart is about to leave through the gate.

consequence.text: The hay is thinner than it looked.

sections.text: The castle walls grow smaller behind you as the sun rises over the forest. Nobody is coming after you. You are now free...
You crawl out of the river onto a muddy bank, far downstream from the castle. Soaked, bleeding, but alive. You are now free...
The captain salutes and waves you through. You walk out of the castle like any guard going home after a long shift, and you never look back. You are now free...
